Cu.description_en: The number of CUs last successfully applied to the EventHouse runtime
Cu.description_zh: EventHouse Runtime 最后成功生效的 CU 数量
Cu.title: CU 数量

ErrorCode.description_en: The standard error code returned when a creation or specification change fails
ErrorCode.description_zh: 创建或变配失败时返回的稳定错误码
ErrorCode.title: 操作错误码

ErrorMessage.description_en: The masked error message returned when a creation or specification change fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 创建或变配失败时返回的脱敏错误信息
ErrorMessage.title: 操作错误信息

Name.description_en: The name of the EventHouse runtime. The initial value is typically default
Name.description_zh: EventHouse Runtime 名称。首期通常为 default
Name.title: 名称

Progress.description_en: The progress of the current creation or specification change operation. Valid values: 0 to 100
Progress.description_zh: 当前创建或变配操作的进度，取值范围为 0 到 100
Progress.title: 操作进度

Stage.description_en: The current stage of the creation or specification change operation
Stage.description_zh: 当前创建或变配操作所处阶段
Stage.title: 操作阶段

Status.description_en: The current status of the EventHouse runtime. RUNNING indicates that the runtime is ready and can process queries. Valid values: CREATING, RUNNING, UPDATING, RECOVERING, CLOSED, CREATE_FAILED, and UPDATE_FAILED
Status.description_zh: EventHouse Runtime 当前状态。RUNNING 表示 Runtime 已就绪且可以承接查询。可能值为 CREATING、RUNNING、UPDATING、RECOVERING、CLOSED、CREATE_FAILED、UPDATE_FAILED
Status.title: Runtime 状态

TargetCu.description_en: The target number of CUs during a creation, specification change, or corresponding failure state. This parameter is not returned when the runtime is stable
TargetCu.description_zh: 创建、变配或对应失败状态下的目标 CU 数量，稳定运行时不返回
TargetCu.title: 目标 CU 数量

parameters.help_en: The name of the EventHouse runtime. If you do not specify this parameter, the default runtime is used. Typically, you do not need to specify this parameter in the initial phase
parameters.help_zh: EventHouse Runtime 名称。不传时使用默认 Runtime。首期通常无需填写
parameters.name: name

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of Success indicates that the operation was successful
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功
Code.title_en: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功
Code.title_zh: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功

Message.description_en: The message returned by the API operation

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the operation was successful
